headline: PSE&G Earns Recognition as one of the Nation's Most Trusted Utility Brands and Most Trusted Business Partners by Escalent
summary: Public Service Electric and Gas Company (PSE&G), New Jersey's largest utility, today announced that independent AI-enabled market research and advisory firm Escalent has named PSE&G a 2026 Most Trusted Utility Brand among residential customers for the third consecutive year. Escalent has also named our company a 2026 Most Trusted Business Partner among business customers.
